text.arabic_uthmani: يَهْدِىٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشْدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ وَلَن نُّشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدًۭا

words.gloss_range: ongoing guidance by the heard recitation toward a named goal, with the guided object left unstated
words.root_gloss_range: leading, directing, showing a way, and conducted orientation; the local frame selects guidance toward rectitude rather than coercion or self-guidance
words.prose: {{ar:يَهْدِىٓ}} ({{tr:yahdī}}) makes the heard recitation's present guiding quality the first claim of the ayah. Its unspoken subject continues from the prior recitation, and its construction leaves the guided audience unstated while naming the destination through the following goal phrase. The root pressure is directional and evaluative: guidance is not coercion but conducted movement toward recognized soundness, and that active quality becomes the reason the speakers move into completed faith. The Form I surface keeps agency on the recitation rather than an intensive, causative, or reflexive alternative, while the final written lengthening gives the opening guidance audible duration. The Qur'an-guides formula is also dramatized through jinn testimony here, with close echoes at 17:9 and 72:13.

topics.headline: present guidance opens the ayah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins with what the heard recitation is actively doing before it reports the speakers' response.
topics.reason: The QAC and attachment evidence read the verb as an imperfect with an implicit masculine singular subject supplied by the prior discourse.

topics.headline: guidance aims through a goal phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the grammar foreground the destination of guidance rather than limiting the event to a named audience.
topics.reason: The local frame has no direct object and uses a governed goal complement, so the destination carries the overt focus.

topics.headline: guidance is conducted orientation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels guidance as direction toward a route-like moral and epistemic goal, not as force or neutral motion.
topics.reason: The local prepositional goal licenses the route-conduct image while the lexical range keeps the action evaluative rather than coercive.

topics.headline: Form I imperfect keeps agency on the recitation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the form presents the recitation as presently leading, while the final lengthening gives the opening verb audible duration before the hearers' response.
topics.reason: The surface is basic Form I imperfect, not an intensive, causative, or reflexive alternative; the final lengthening is a surface pressure, not an independent sense.

topics.headline: guidance becomes witnessed faith
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a general Qur'an-guides claim become the jinn's own witnessed sequence of guidance, faith, and confession.
topics.reason: The local order moves from present guidance to completed belief, and the supplied recurrence rows connect this formulation with 17:9 and 72:13.

words.gloss_range: goal and endpoint marker that makes rectitude the destination of guidance
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَى}} ({{tr:ilā}}) is the visible hinge that turns guidance into movement toward a goal. It does not make rectitude an instrument or a possessed object; it marks an endpoint that the guiding action faces. Because the preposition is separate and placed before the response clause, the reader sees the destination named before faith is reported, and the syntactic link is also audible through the article's waṣl link in recitation.

topics.headline: preposition marks the destination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that guidance is described as oriented toward rectitude, not as bare motion or a direct-object action.
topics.reason: The particle governs the following genitive noun as the goal complement of the guidance verb.

topics.headline: goal relation blocks instrument reading
topics.reader_payoff: The reader avoids reading rectitude as a tool handed over or an attachment, and instead hears it as the oriented endpoint.
topics.reason: The local grammar identifies the governed phrase as a goal, not an instrument or attachment relation.

topics.headline: separate particle exposes the link
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can see and hear the directional relation as its own mechanism between the guide and the goal.
topics.reason: The preposition is written separately and directly governs the next noun, so the dependency remains explicit.

topics.headline: destination precedes faith response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees belief grounded in a disclosed destination rather than in an unnamed emotional reaction.
topics.reason: The goal phrase completes the first clause before the consequence clause begins.

words.gloss_range: definite rectitude or sound direction as the named goal of guidance, including mature judgment and recognized correctness
words.root_gloss_range: right course, rectitude, mature judgment, and sound discernment; the local gerund names the goal-quality rather than an already guided actor
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلرُّشْدِ}} ({{tr:al-rushd}}) is not a loose improvement term; as a definite genitive goal, it names the recognized soundness toward which guidance leads. Its root range joins right course with mature judgment, so the response of faith answers discernment as well as direction. Variant vocalizations keep the same root and target while shifting recitational texture, so they illuminate the word's pressure without replacing the local compact form. The word also belongs to a guidance-rectitude and lordship thread, with the contrastive pole in 2:256 and same-surah recurrences at 72:10, 72:14, and 72:21 helping mark the goal as stable before the response clause.

topics.headline: definite rectitude is the goal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the goal as recognized rectitude, not as vague improvement or an independent actor.
topics.reason: The noun is definite, genitive, and governed by the goal preposition after the guidance verb.

topics.headline: right course includes mature judgment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the guidance as forming competent discernment, not merely pointing to a correct route.
topics.reason: The root evidence supports rectitude, right course, and mature correctness; the local noun makes that range the destination of guidance.

topics.headline: variants shade the same target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a recitational pressure point around the word's vowel profile while the semantic target remains stable.
topics.reason: The variant rows can clarify vocalic texture and semantic robustness, but they do not replace the aligned local surface.

topics.headline: noun names the quality, not the hearers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees rectitude itself as the target before the hearers' status is shown by their response.
topics.reason: The local form is a definite gerund-like noun governed as a goal, not an adjective describing the speakers.

topics.headline: rectitude links guidance and lordship
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees this goal join larger patterns of guidance, error-contrast, and local lordship rather than functioning as a casual synonym.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows name 2:256, same-surah recurrence, and local co-occurrence with guidance and lordship; these are concrete links rather than free inventions.

topics.headline: goal lands before faith
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah first lands on the named goal, then lets faith appear as the consequence.
topics.reason: The word closes the opening guidance phrase before the consequence particle introduces the belief clause.

words.gloss_range: consequence particle that fastens completed belief to the preceding guidance claim
words.prose: {{ar:فَـَٔ}} ({{tr:fa-}}) is the hinge from recognized guidance to response. It makes the belief clause follow as consequence, not as a detached report, and its force attaches to completed faith before the ayah moves to refusal. The clitic shape fuses that consequence to the belief verb, while the sharp onset marks a boundary where hearing and recognized guidance cross into confession.

topics.headline: faith follows as consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices belief as the direct consequence of guidance rather than as a separate emotional report.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the following belief clause as resulting from the guidance clause.

topics.headline: consequence attaches before refusal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the particle's consequence force on faith, while the later refusal remains coordinated after it.
topics.reason: The particle begins the belief clause; the negated refusal is introduced later by separate coordination.

topics.headline: fused particle marks a sharp hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can feel the syntax turn quickly from received guidance into stated belief.
topics.reason: The prefixed particle is split as its own word segment but visibly binds to the following belief verb.

words.gloss_range: completed first-person plural faith as trustful assent to the heard recitation
words.root_gloss_range: security, trust, faith, and making oneself safe in allegiance; the local Form IV perfect selects committed belief rather than merely becoming safe
words.prose: {{ar:امَنَّا}} ({{tr:āmannā}}) lands as completed plural faith immediately after the consequence particle. The speakers are not just impressed; they commit trust to the heard message through its governed complement. The security field behind the root gives belief the feel of protected reliance, while Form IV makes that security into committed assent rather than simply becoming safe. Structurally, this word is the ayah's middle pivot: active guidance produces completed faith, and completed faith then receives a forward boundary in the refusal of association, a pattern echoed again at 72:13.

topics.headline: completed plural belief
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that faith is presented as a completed communal response by the speaking jinn.
topics.reason: The verb is first-person plural perfect and is introduced as the consequence of the preceding guidance clause.

topics.headline: belief takes a governed complement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees faith directed to the heard recitation through a governed complement rather than floating as a bare attitude.
topics.reason: The following prepositional pronoun is attached as the complement of the belief verb and resumes the prior heard recitation.

topics.headline: faith carries security as trust
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels belief as trustful reliance and protected commitment, not bare opinion.
topics.reason: The root range supports security and trust, and the local faith construction directs that range to the believed-in message.

topics.headline: Form IV makes security into assent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the morphology selecting committed belief rather than simply entering a state of safety.
topics.reason: The local verb is Form IV perfect in the faith construction, not an intransitive safety state.

topics.headline: faith mediates guidance and refusal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees belief as the pivot between recognized guidance and the later pledge not to associate partners.
topics.reason: The ayah orders guidance, consequence-faith, and coordinated refusal in a single response sequence.

topics.headline: faith formula recurs in the surah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees this belief statement as the first local articulation of a same-surah heard-guidance confession pattern (72:13).
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows supply 72:13 as a concrete recurrence of faith after hearing guidance.

words.gloss_range: prepositional pronoun complement marking the believed-in prior recitation as object, attachment, and basis of faith
words.prose: {{ar:بِهِۦ}} ({{tr:bihi}}) compresses the belief object into a preposition plus pronoun. The suffix resumes the prior heard recitation, so the speakers do not repeat the noun; they attach their faith to it. The particle gives the complement the force of object, attachment, and basis, and its placement closes the belief beat before the ayah turns to the coordinated refusal.

topics.headline: pronoun resumes the heard recitation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the pronoun as carrying the prior recitation into the faith clause without restating it.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence resolves the masculine singular suffix to the heard recitation from the preceding statement.

topics.headline: preposition marks attached faith
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears faith as attached to and grounded in the heard message, not as an ungoverned reaction.
topics.reason: The local faith verb takes the prepositional pronoun as its governed complement.

topics.headline: compact complement closes the belief beat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a compact closure to faith before the syntax pivots to refusal.
topics.reason: The preposition and suffix form one segment after the belief verb and before the coordinated negated clause.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction joining completed faith to the forward negated pledge
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) resets the sentence after faith and joins it to the refusal that follows. Because the ayah uses coordination here rather than another consequence particle, the second clause is not a new result of guidance in the same way as belief; it is the pledged boundary that stands alongside faith. The small clitic lets affirmation and refusal remain linked without collapsing them into one clause.

topics.headline: coordination replaces another consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the refusal is coordinated with faith, not introduced as the same immediate consequence particle used for belief.
topics.reason: The particle begins the coordinated negated clause after the faith clause.

topics.headline: faith and refusal stand together
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the response as both positive trust and negative non-association.
topics.reason: The coordinated clause connects the completed faith statement with the future negated pledge.

topics.headline: short clitic resets the cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a brief reset before the longer negated pledge begins.
topics.reason: The conjunction is a prefixed segment split from the following negator, giving a compact transition.

words.gloss_range: prospective negator governing the following subjunctive verb and projecting the pledge into future policy
words.prose: {{ar:لَن}} ({{tr:lan}}) changes completed faith into a forward boundary. It governs the following subjunctive verb and projects negation over the association act and its final object, so the pledge is not just a present feeling but a future policy. As a separate visible governor after the coordinating clitic, it gives the ayah's final architecture its negated scope: the earlier wonder has become recognized guidance and faith, and association will not even be initiated.

topics.headline: future negation governs the pledge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the refusal projected forward as a policy, not merely as a present denial.
topics.reason: The particle is a future negator governing the following verb and its complements.

topics.headline: negator controls mood
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb's form is grammatically held under the negator's control.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark the following verb as subjunctive under this particle.

topics.headline: negation reaches the excluded object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the negation cover the association act through to the final excluded candidate.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the negator govern the verb whose complements include the protected relation and the final object.

topics.headline: separate negator opens final architecture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears and sees the turn from wonder and faith into a firm future boundary.
topics.reason: The negator remains a separate word after the coordinating clitic and begins the final negated clause.

words.gloss_range: first-person plural subjunctive association act under future negation, with an explicit candidate object and protected Lord relation
words.root_gloss_range: sharing, partnership, assigning a share, and religious association; local Form IV under negation selects making or assigning a partner in lordship
words.prose: {{ar:نُّشْرِكَ}} ({{tr:nushrika}}) is the act the speakers now refuse to perform. Its first-person plural keeps agency with the same group that believed, while the negator and subjunctive make the refusal prospective. The verb divides the forbidden act into two complements: the protected Lord relation and the final candidate object. The root's sharing field is therefore narrowed into religious association here, not neutral cooperation; Form IV makes the wrongness an assigned partner-status. The doubled initial nūn makes the prohibited action audibly pressed against the negation as the pledge hardens. The refusal echoes broader no-association formulas, including 31:13 and 72:20, but here it is adopted as the jinn's own communal vow.

topics.headline: same speakers refuse association
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the believing speakers themselves take responsibility for the future refusal.
topics.reason: The verb is first-person plural and is governed by the preceding future negator.

topics.headline: partner and violated relation are separated
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the candidate partner and the Lord relation occupy different grammatical slots.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence gives the verb both a prepositional complement for the Lord relation and an explicit accusative object for the candidate partner.

topics.headline: sharing becomes forbidden association
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees ordinary sharing language become morally charged because it intrudes on lordship.
topics.reason: The local pairing with the Lord relation selects religious association from the broader sharing field.

topics.headline: Form IV assigns partnership
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the action as making or assigning partner-status, not reciprocal sharing among equals.
topics.reason: The local form is Form IV under negation, while reciprocal or participatory alternatives are not the chosen surface.

topics.headline: refusal is faith's boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees positive belief immediately acquire a negative boundary.
topics.reason: The negated verb is coordinated after the completed faith clause and supplies its forward limit.

topics.headline: communal vow joins wider formulas
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the jinn's pledge join a broader no-association formula while retaining its local first-person voice (31:13; 72:20).
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows provide concrete references where non-association language is prohibited or repeated.

topics.headline: sound compresses the negated action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the negated action as compact and pressured at the point where the pledge hardens.
topics.reason: The sound observation is tied to the same mood, form, and lordship-pairing convergence rather than standing alone.

words.gloss_range: association preposition governing the Lord phrase after the negated association verb
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi-}}) marks the relation beside which a partner would be joined. It is not beneficiary or instrument language; with the association verb, it governs the Lord phrase as the protected relation. Its bare clitic form contrasts with the earlier pronoun-bound belief complement: faith kept the believed-in message pronominal, while this pledge fully names the Lord relation before the final excluded candidate arrives. The bound phrase also carries compact bāʾ, doubled-b, and nasal pressure before the final open-ended object.

topics.headline: preposition marks association relation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the preposition identify the relation in which partnership would be committed.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the preposition govern the Lord noun as the association complement of the negated verb.

topics.headline: withness is constrained by the verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader avoids turning the Lord phrase into a beneficiary or tool and instead hears the forbidden with-relation.
topics.reason: The local construction with the association verb selects relation or accompaniment, not instrumentality.

topics.headline: bare clitic contrasts earlier complement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the belief object compressed into a pronoun earlier, while the protected Lord relation is now fully named.
topics.reason: This preposition is a bare prefixed segment attached to an explicit noun, unlike the earlier preposition-plus-pronoun complement.

topics.headline: Lord relation precedes excluded object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees what is protected named before the ayah names the universal excluded class, with the bound phrase carrying compact pressure before the final object.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase precedes the final accusative object within the negated clause.

words.gloss_range: suffix-bound singular Lord phrase, governed after the association preposition as the protected relation of the believing speakers
words.root_gloss_range: lordship, mastery, ownership, regulation, sustaining care, and nurture to completion; local use selects exclusive relational lordship
words.prose: {{ar:رَبِّنَآ}} ({{tr:rabbinā}}) names the relation the speakers protect: not lordship in the abstract, but their own Lord, bound by the first-person plural suffix. The noun is definite through possession, genitive after the association preposition, and singular before the final universal exclusion, so the grammar places exclusive lordship before any possible partner is named. Its root range holds authority and sustaining care together, making association a violation of the source that governs and nurtures them. The doubled bāʾ compresses authority, then the long final nā extends that authority into the speakers' plural possession. The word then becomes part of the surah's lordship spine, immediately magnified at 72:3 and aligned with the prophetic no-association statement at 72:20.

topics.headline: suffix makes lordship relational
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the refusal protect the speakers' acknowledged Lord relation, not an abstract title.
topics.reason: The noun carries a first-person plural possessive suffix and is governed inside the negated association clause.

topics.headline: possession defines singular lordship
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices definiteness through relationship and singular lordship before the ayah excludes any partner.
topics.reason: The possessed singular noun is definite through the suffix rather than through an article, and no plural lord form is used.

topics.headline: Lord is the violated relation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the Lord phrase as the relation in which association would be committed.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive under the preposition governed by the association verb and also carries a possessive suffix.

topics.headline: lordship includes rule and care
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels association as a violation of both governing authority and sustaining care.
topics.reason: The root range supports lord, owner, master, sustainer, regulator, and nurture-to-completion, while the local noun selects relational lordship.

topics.headline: faith culminates in protected lordship
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees trust culminate in allegiance to the Lord whose relation cannot be shared.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows connect faith, guidance, lordship, and association within the ayah and same-surah patterns, including 72:10 and 72:20.

topics.headline: protected relation precedes universal exclusion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees what is protected placed before the final class of excluded partners.
topics.reason: The Lord phrase stands before the final accusative object within the closing negated clause.

topics.headline: lordship is immediately expanded
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the no-partner pledge become part of a wider lordship thread, magnified in 72:3 and echoed in 72:20.
topics.reason: The source rows give concrete same-surah references where the Lord phrase is expanded and where no-association is restated.

topics.headline: sound compresses authority into possession
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the word tighten around authority and then extend into the speakers' plural possession.
topics.reason: The sound note is tied to the shaddah and final possessive lengthening in the local surface.

words.gloss_range: indefinite singular object under future negation, excluding any individual candidate partner at all
words.root_gloss_range: oneness, singularity, any one, and individual candidate force; local negation turns singularity into universal exclusion
words.prose: {{ar:أَحَدًۭا}} ({{tr:aḥadan}}) seals the ayah by turning a singular object into universal exclusion. Because it is indefinite under the future negation, it means no candidate at all, and because it is the delayed accusative object, it arrives only after the Lord relation has been protected. The unity field makes each possible one a test case already ruled out; this is stronger than merely naming a numerical one. Its firm dāl before tanwīn gives the universal exclusion a hard final landing after the long relational phrase. The closing word also joins same-surah and cross-surah oneness patterns, with 112:1 asserting absolute oneness and 72:20 repeating the no-association formula.

topics.headline: indefinite object universalizes exclusion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final noun exclude anyone at all, not only a known or listed partner.
topics.reason: The noun is indefinite and falls under the scope of the future negator governing the association verb.

topics.headline: final object names the candidate partner
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the candidate partner named as the object only after the protected Lord relation has been stated.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the noun as the explicit accusative object of the negated association verb.

topics.headline: one becomes anyone at all
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels every possible individual claimant excluded one by one while the class becomes universal.
topics.reason: The lexical field supports singular one and anyone-at-all force, and negation supplies the universal reading.

topics.headline: singular indefinite form opens the class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the form avoids a list and makes any single candidate sufficient for exclusion.
topics.reason: The local noun is singular indefinite with tanwīn and is not the merely numerical alternative in the unity family.

topics.headline: final word joins oneness formulas
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final exclusion answer absolute oneness (112:1) and recur in the surah's no-association formula (72:20).
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows provide concrete references for absolute oneness and same-surah repetition of the final exclusion.

topics.headline: closing word seals the response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the whole ayah framed from recognized guidance to total non-association, with the excluded candidate class left last.
topics.reason: The noun closes the ayah after the protected Lord relation and completes the guidance-to-faith-to-boundary sequence.

topics.headline: sound gives final exclusion a landing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the universal exclusion land decisively at the end of the ayah.
topics.reason: The sound observation is tied to the final position and the word's closing consonantal shape.

baseline_models.mechanism: The focus verse presents a causal sequence: gentle direction toward a straight and practically sound course reaches trusting assent, with fa- marking belief as the hearers' immediate response to what the discourse does.

activation_trace.role: Gentle direction toward a way supplies both the guiding action and its non-coercive mode.
A straight course away from error supplies the destination's directional shape.
Sound handling of an affair makes the destination practical judgment, not information alone.
Heart-settling confirmation supplies the receptive result of being guided.

changed_reading.before: The discourse contains correct instruction, and the hearers then believe it.
changed_reading.after: The discourse performs a directional act: it leads the hearers into a straight, practically sound course, and trusting assent follows as its immediate uptake.

baseline_models.mechanism: The irreversible pledge removes every sharer from relation to 'our Lord': authority, nurture, and lasting allegiance are not divisible, while ahadan exhausts the class of possible partners.

activation_trace.role: Settled security and trust make the following pledge a stable allegiance rather than a momentary opinion.
Sharing and partnership provide the relation that the pledge categorically refuses.
Association with God fixes the refused partnership in the theological register of the clause.
Lordship, ownership, and authority identify the domain that cannot be shared.
Repair, nurture, and completion make exclusive lordship formative as well as sovereign.
Exhaustive 'anyone' under negation closes every possible exception to the pledge.

changed_reading.before: The converts promise not to worship another deity.
changed_reading.after: Their new trust becomes undivided allegiance: no claimant may share the authority, nurture, or completion belonging to their Lord.

baseline_models.mechanism: The focus branches permit a movement model: guidance establishes intended direction and a straight course, while shirk evokes rival ruts, a snare, and a divided mind. The pledge protects the route of rushd from capture by competing tracks or allegiances.

activation_trace.role: Course, manner, and intended direction turn guidance into sustained orientation.
The straight course supplies the viable route toward which the hearers are turned.
Path ruts provide the image of rival tracks competing with the course of rushd.
A hunter's snare makes partnership a form of capture that arrests directed movement.
A divided or preoccupied mind supplies the inward counterpart to competing external tracks.

changed_reading.before: Belief and non-association are two adjacent declarations.
changed_reading.after: Non-association is also the route consequence of guidance: straightened direction displaces rival tracks, snares, and divided attention.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding ayah supplies the object and reception event omitted by the focus: a divinely disclosed recitation is deliberately heard, understood, and recognized as unfamiliar. The focus's guiding and believing clauses are therefore the effect phase of a concrete auditory encounter.

activation_trace.role: Gentle direction names what the heard discourse does after reception.
Trusting confirmation supplies the encounter's resulting uptake.
A report or inspiration from God supplies the discourse's hidden sending source.
Hearing as understanding and compliance makes reception more than acoustic contact.
Gathering and collection give the heard material coherence as a discourse.
Reading and recitation provide the audible vehicle by which the gathered discourse reaches them.
Wonder at an unfamiliar matter marks the expectation-breaking recognition that opens the changed reading.

structural_cues: 72:1 immediately supplies a heard Qur'an and the speakers' report before the focus verse.
The singular pronoun in bihi follows the indefinite Qur'an across the ayah boundary.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealed disclosure, deliberate hearing, recitation, and wonder; I infer that this reception chain mediates the focus's guidance-to-faith arrow. A live alternative is that bihi points to guidance itself rather than specifically to the recited Qur'an.

changed_reading.before: A proposition about guidance is followed by belief.
changed_reading.after: A surprising recited disclosure is heard into understanding, performs guidance, and elicits trusting assent in one reception event.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus pledge now opposes an epistemic and social system: reckless overreaching speech about God and falsehood support human recourse to jinn patrons, while that refuge relation increases oppressive burden. Faith in the Lord transfers trust away from both false claims and surrogate protection.

activation_trace.role: Settled security and trust provide the replacement for unreliable speech and refuge.
Partnership supplies the relational category instantiated by outsourcing protection.
Lordship and authority identify the sole locus to which trust is transferred.
Saying or attributing what was not supplies the false-claim mechanism about God.
Lightness of mind and deficient forbearance characterize the speaker generating those claims.
Deviation and injustice away from truth give the speech its directional opposition to rushd.
The opposite of truth names the failed assumption on which the old trust system rested.
Seeking shelter and protection supplies the practical dependency that functions like partnership.
Increase and growth provide the explicit causal escalation produced by the refuge relation.
Oppressive burden and overtaxing name what the surrogate protection actually increases.

structural_cues: 72:4-5 pair overreaching speech with the speakers' former assumption that humans and jinn would not lie about God.
72:6 repeats 'men' on both sides of the refuge relation and uses fa- to connect refuge with increased rahaq.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies false God-talk, refuge in jinn patrons, and an explicit increase in burden; I infer that practical reliance is one social form of the partnership rejected in 72:2. Alternatively, the refuge episode may illustrate error without exhausting the wider scope of shirk.

changed_reading.before: The pledge rejects an abstract theological error.
changed_reading.after: The pledge dismantles a lived protection economy: false authorities and patrons are abandoned because their promised refuge deepens the burden that trust sought to escape.

context_deltas.mechanism: The former practice of seeking the sky from fixed listening stations now meets surveillance and leaves the speakers admitting that they do not know what is intended on earth. Against that failed acquisition mode, the focus depicts guidance as an openly heard discourse that yields accountable trust rather than possession of hidden intelligence.

activation_trace.role: Gentle direction toward truth contrasts with extracting inaccessible information.
Sound judgment supplies an action-guiding result even where hidden intention remains unknown.
Settled trust is the alternative epistemic posture to covert information capture.
Seeking and feeling for something makes contact with the sky an attempted acquisition.
Sitting in wait to monitor supplies the fixed surveillance posture of the former listeners.
Auditory perception names the channel being pursued and lets it contrast with hearing-as-understanding in 72:1.
Watching and guarding close the old listening route and reverse observer into observed.
Knowledge and awareness, explicitly negated in the ayah, mark the limit of the failed acquisition mode.

structural_cues: 72:8-9 moves from seeking contact with the sky to former listening seats and a present guard.
72:10 begins with 'we do not know' before contrasting evil with Lord-intended rushd.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attempted contact, listening stations, guards, and admitted non-knowledge; I infer a contrast between captured intelligence and received guidance. A live alternative is that the sky scene reports a changed condition without morally classifying every earlier act of listening.

changed_reading.before: Guidance gives the hearers privileged information about hidden affairs.
changed_reading.after: Guidance does not make them owners of hidden intelligence; it gives enough orientation for trust and sound action while their confession of non-knowledge remains intact.

context_deltas.mechanism: Ayah 72:13 nearly replays the focus's hearing-guidance-belief sequence, then unfolds the security latent in aman: trust in the Lord is not exposed to anticipated terror, diminished due, or crushing imposition. The reprise confirms the causal chain and gives its settled trust a non-extractive social texture.

activation_trace.role: Settled security and trust in the focus are the semantic potential that the reprise expands.
Nurture and completion make the Lord relation compatible with protection from loss and overburdening.
Hearing as understanding and compliance restarts the same reception chain explicitly.
Gentle direction toward truth names what is heard and directly echoes the focus's guiding verb.
Settled security and trust bind the repeated belief response to its stated consequences.
Dread of an expected harm supplies the affective condition that faithful trust removes.
Diminution of right or worth specifies the extractive loss that the believer need not fear.
Oppressive overburdening supplies the second harm excluded from the trust relation.

structural_cues: The sequence 'when we heard the guidance, we believed in it' closely reprises 72:1-2.
The singular believer clause then coordinates no bakhs and no rahaq under no fear.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact reception reprise followed by three harm terms; I infer that these terms unpack the security component of iman in the focus. Alternatively, the assurance may be eschatological without describing the believers' immediate psychology or social conditions.

changed_reading.before: Belief is assent to correct guidance.
changed_reading.after: Belief is settled trust in a Lord whose guidance neither cheats the hearer of due nor crushes the hearer with added burden.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated rushd clauses distribute agency: the Lord may intend rushd for people, those who hand themselves over deliberately seek it, and the messenger denies possessing it for others. The focus's Qur'an guides toward a divinely intended orientation that hearers must enter, not a benefit controlled and dispensed at human will.

activation_trace.role: Gentle direction supplies mediation toward rushd without implying human ownership of it.
Sound judgment in handling an affair identifies the practical orientation whose agency is redistributed.
Will and intention make rushd an intended outcome amid the speakers' uncertainty.
Sound handling names the good orientation that the ayah attributes to the Lord's intent.
Handing over and relinquishing supply the receptive posture from which rushd is deliberately sought.
Practical soundness becomes the explicit object of the seekers' effort.
Ownership and power of disposal, here negated, deny that the speaker controls outcomes for the audience.
Harm and diminution supply the negative pole paired with rushd under denied possession.
The same practical soundness is explicitly not something the messenger owns for others.

structural_cues: 72:10 contrasts uncertain evil with the Lord's intending rushd.
The branchless root ح ر ي at 72:14 makes rushd the object of deliberate seeking and is used only as a structural cue.
72:21 pairs harm and rushd under the messenger's denial of possession.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies intention, deliberate search, and denied possession around repeated rushd; I infer that these clauses separate divine source, receptive pursuit, and messenger control. Alternatively, 72:21 may deny power to cause the outcomes rather than treating rushd as something figuratively owned.

changed_reading.before: The messenger or text hands over a finished package called right guidance.
changed_reading.after: The discourse points into Lord-intended soundness that hearers must seek and inhabit, while the messenger expressly lacks autonomous control over that outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's directional branches expand into a route ecology: plural paths are cut apart, one way can be made straight, that alignment opens abundant water, abundance itself tests, and turning one's side away results in being inserted into an uphill hardship. Rushd is thus a traversed and tested orientation, not a static label or an automatic prosperity signal.

activation_trace.role: Course, manner, and intended direction provide the focus anchor for the expanded route system.
A straight course away from error supplies the normative geometry of the route.
Path ruts give non-association a spatial role as refusal of competing tracks.
An extended route supplies the common material for the speakers' plural paths.
Divergent paths and groups make the route field visibly split rather than uniform.
Straightness, balance, and level alignment supply the condition applied to the way.
The extended path gives the straightened condition a traversable object.
Giving drink supplies the causal provision released upon route alignment.
Ordinary water provides the material medium of that provision.
Abundance of water and provision marks the route's apparently favorable yield.
Testing metal or a person reverses abundance from final reward into an assay of response.
Turning one's side away provides the bodily deviation that breaks route alignment.
Inserting one thing into another supplies the counter-routing into hardship.
A difficult ascent gives the adverse route its resistant gradient.

structural_cues: 72:11 names the speakers as divided paths; 72:16 conditions abundant water on straightness upon the path.
72:17 immediately states a testing purpose, then contrasts turning away with being made to enter ascending hardship.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies split paths, straightness, provision, testing, lateral turning, insertion, and ascent; I infer one functional route system linking them. A live alternative is that water is literal provision and the later punishment is a separate consequence rather than part of a shared spatial analogy.

changed_reading.before: Guidance identifies the correct path and prosperity confirms arrival.
changed_reading.after: Guidance establishes a traversable orientation through divided tracks; even abundant provision tests that orientation, while turning aside produces a resistant counter-route.

context_deltas.mechanism: Ayat 72:18-20 enact the focus pledge in address and worship: places of prostration are assigned to God, calling anyone alongside God is barred, and the servant's own crowded act is to call his Lord without association. Exclusive allegiance governs the destination of invocation even amid intense social plurality.

activation_trace.role: Lordship and authority identify the exclusive addressee of the later call.
Association with God supplies the focus prohibition that the later speech repeats in practice.
Exhaustive anyone under negation leaves no secondary destination for invocation.
A place of prostration supplies the cultic setting in which exclusivity is exercised.
Calling and inclining by speech provide the concrete act that must remain undivided.
Exhaustive anyone extends the focus's no-exception pledge into the prohibition on co-calling.
Submissive worship identifies the caller through enacted obedience rather than autonomous power.
A dense mass piled layer upon layer supplies the crowding social pressure around the undivided call.
The speaker's own calling turns the prohibition into a first-person practice.
Lordship and authority specify the one addressee of that practice.
Association with God is again explicitly denied, echoing the focus pledge.
Exhaustive anyone closes the repeated first-person denial without exception.

structural_cues: 72:18 moves from God's claim over the masajid directly to a ban on calling anyone with God.
72:19 places a densely gathered crowd around the servant's call, and 72:20 repeats the focus's Lord-shirk-anyone wording in the first person.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prostration space, exclusive calling, servant worship, crowding, and a near-verbatim first-person denial; I infer that the focus pledge governs invocation under social pressure. Alternatively, da'wa may include proclamation as well as prayer, so the model should not reduce every occurrence to ritual petition.

changed_reading.before: Non-association is an inward creed or a count of deities.
changed_reading.after: Non-association is performed by keeping address, prostration, and allegiance directed to one Lord even when many bodies crowd around the act.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence distinguishes a rival from a dependent envoy. There is no independent refuge from God, yet hidden knowledge may be disclosed to an approved messenger; the messenger is inserted within guards, delivery reaches its goal, and the whole relay is encompassed and enumerated. The focus rejects co-lordship without erasing authorized mediation under the Lord's control.

activation_trace.role: Lordship and authority provide the sovereign pole under which the relay operates.
Sharing and partnership name the independent status denied to every intermediary.
Exhaustive anyone closes the field of rival protectors while leaving the later exception structurally dependent.
Protection through neighborhood or pledged shelter, here denied, removes any independent protector from God.
Turning toward a refuge supplies the side-exit that the speaker says he cannot find.
Conveying a message supplies the permitted task remaining after autonomous refuge and power are denied.
Messenger and message define mediation as an assigned relation rather than shared sovereignty.
What is hidden from eyes supplies the protected content whose disclosure remains sovereign.
Emergence and disclosure provide the controlled movement of hidden content into manifestation.
Approval rather than displeasure supplies the selection condition for the messenger exception.
The messenger is the approved relay role, not a co-owner of the hidden.
Insertion of one thing within another makes the guards an enclosing arrangement around the relay.
Watching and guarding supply active supervision of the messenger's transmission corridor.
Conveying the messages marks completion of the assigned relay rather than acquisition of sovereignty.
Complete encompassing in knowledge and control closes the relay within divine oversight.
Exhaustive enumeration makes oversight auditable down to every item.
Counting the counted supplies the final image of nothing in the relay escaping account.

structural_cues: 72:26-27 frames disclosure as an exception for an approved messenger rather than a general opening of the unseen.
The guard is placed before the messenger and behind him, followed by delivery, encompassing, and counting in 72:28.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies no refuge, an approved-messenger exception, surrounding guards, completed delivery, and total accounting; I infer that exclusive lordship excludes independent rivals but permits dependent mediation. Alternatively, the guards may protect the message, attest delivery, or do both, and the packet does not settle that directional function.

changed_reading.before: Refusing every partner means that no mediation can stand between the Lord and hearers.
changed_reading.after: Refusing partners distinguishes rival agency from authorized relay: a messenger may carry disclosed guidance precisely because selection, route, protection, and accounting remain under one Lord.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the gift branch of h-d-y under a guiding verb; it remains anchored in yahdi and coheres with settled aman and nurturing rabb. Downstream prose should present it as a relational branch resonance, not replace the verb's ordinary guidance sense with 'gives a gift.'

activation_trace.role: A gracious gift sent to someone close makes guidance relationally offered rather than merely commanded.
Settled security and trust supply the inward reception of that gracious offering.
Nurture and completion identify the giver relation to which the pledge answers.

changed_reading.before: Guidance is an instruction that wins assent.
changed_reading.after: Guidance can also be heard as a gracious relational offering whose reception settles trust and elicits exclusive loyalty to the nurturing Lord.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising and form-distant because it uses the packet's non-dominant h-d-d mapping for the focus occurrence of h-d-y; it remains formally anchored by that explicit split mapping and gains focus coherence from the rejected partnership structure. Downstream prose must label it an exploratory activation or material analogy, never a translation or etymological claim.

activation_trace.role: Collapse and severe breaking supply an exploratory destructive phase within the guiding event.
Partnership supplies the prior relational structure imagined as being broken apart.
The straight course supplies the viable orientation that becomes available after that break.

changed_reading.before: Guidance only points toward a better course.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the guiding encounter first breaks the inherited architecture of shared allegiance so that a straight course can be entered.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the non-dominant r-b-w target supplied for rabb; it remains anchored by the same focus occurrence and is stabilized by the dominant rabb branch of nurture and completion. Downstream prose should qualify growth as a secondary split-root resonance, not identify rabb lexically with r-b-w.

activation_trace.role: Repair, nurture, and completion establish the dominant formative sense of the Lord relation.
Nurture and growing up add an exploratory image of development under a single source.
Partnership supplies the rival formative claim excluded from that developmental relation.

changed_reading.before: The pledge recognizes one sovereign owner.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the pledge also entrusts growth and completion to one formative source and refuses rival claims over what the hearers are becoming.

strongest_changes: The focus becomes the effect phase of a heard, surprising revelation event rather than a detached proposition.
The near-verbatim reprise in 72:13 confirms the hearing-guidance-belief chain and unfolds iman as protection from dread, diminution, and oppressive burden.
Repeated rushd distributes agency among divine intention, human seeking, and the messenger's lack of autonomous possession.
Path, water, testing, lateral turning, insertion, and difficult ascent turn guidance into a route maintained under both provision and pressure.
The no-partner pledge becomes both a break from false protection networks and an enacted discipline of undivided invocation.
Exclusive lordship remains compatible with an approved, guarded, and fully audited messenger relay because mediation is dependent rather than rival.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly reintroduced the focus's own roots in altered functional settings: hearing became understanding, aman became non-extractive security, rushd became intended yet sought and unowned, and shirk moved from doctrine into refuge, route, and invocation. Split mappings also exposed contained but live gift, breaking, and growth resonances that a conservative synthesis would likely lose.
remaining_uncertainties: The antecedent of bihi can be heard as the Qur'an, the guidance, or their fused event.
The route-provision-test model may join literal consequences through one analogy more tightly than the syntax requires.
The range of da'wa in 72:18-20 may include proclamation as well as ritual petition.
The guards in 72:27 may protect transmission, attest delivery, or perform both functions.
The gift, h-d-d breaking, and r-b-w growth outliers are branch activations and must not be promoted into lexical translations.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Guidance as a course that reorganizes allegiance.** `يهدي` activates ه د ي B001-B002, gentle guidance and intended course; `الرشد` activates ر ش د B001-B002, a straight course and sound management; `آمنا` activates ء م ن B001-B002, settled security and trusting assent; `نشرك` activates ش ر ك B001-B002, partnership and associating a partner; and `ربنا` activates ر ب ب B001-B002, authority joined to nurture. The grammar runs causally from guidance, to trust, to refusal of divided allegiance. The abductive move is that a sound course is not only information but a reallocation of reliance. The ayah therefore reads as guidance producing a secure, undivided relation to the nurturing Lord.

2. **A single route replacing traps and competing tracks.** The dormant images in ش ر ك B005-B006 are path-ruts and a hunter’s snare, while `أحدا` activates ء ح د B002, exhaustive “anyone.” In a surah that later contrasts diverging paths (72:11), deliberate path-selection (72:14), and standing straight on the path (72:16), partnership can be spatially modeled as capture by intersecting tracks. The causal arrow is inferred: divided attachment entangles movement. The refusal to associate anyone thus reads as release from rival route-systems, not only as a doctrinal proposition.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The route reading becomes visible only after 72:11, 72:14, and 72:16 supply divergent paths, careful aiming, and upright standing. Later 72:21 also corrects any transfer of agency to the messenger: he conveys `رشد` but does not own it.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Guidance is a traversable course with a practical test.** Fixed `ه د ي` B001 is gentle indication toward a road or truth and B002 is a matter's course, manner, and intended direction; fixed `ر ش د` B001 is a straight course away from error and B002 is sound handling of an affair. The window moves from hearing (72:1) through claims and assumptions (72:3-5) to the concrete failed refuge arrangement of 72:6 and the shared supposition of 72:7. The packet supplies direction language and examples of defective judgment; I infer that the recitation's guidance is validated by replacing an unworkable social practice. The clause reads as routing conduct and judgment, not simply furnishing information.

2. **Belief creates security by ending divided reliance.** Fixed `ء م ن` B002 is trusting assent, with B001 retaining settled security against fear; fixed `ش ر ك` B001 is shared participation and B008 a divided or preoccupied mind. In 72:6, humans seek protection through jinn and receive increased `رَهَقًا`, while 72:7 names the assumptions shared across both populations. The packet supplies assent, partitioned partnership, refuge, and worsening pressure; I infer the causal arrow that exclusive reliance removes the dependency that produced insecurity. `فَـَٔامَنَّا ... وَلَن نُّشْرِكَ` thus reads as one security-producing reconfiguration rather than two unrelated declarations.

3. **`أَحَدًا` closes every available slot.** Fixed `ء ح د` B002 is exhaustive "anyone" under negation, while B005 adds distribution into separate individuals. Its position after `لَن نُّشْرِكَ` blocks not only a named rival but each possible participant, including the human/jinn pair that appears in 72:5-6. The packet supplies exhaustive negation and the nearby cross-species network; I infer that the singular form audits the network person by person. The ending reads as a structural prohibition on filling any partnership slot.

4. **Lordship includes staged repair.** Fixed `ر ب ب` B002 is repair, nurture, administration, and completion stage by stage, alongside B001 lordship and authority. The local sequence advances from hearing, to assent, to corrected claims and corrected refuge. The packet supplies the nurturing branch and an ordered sequence of cognitive and social correction; I infer that `رَبِّنَا` names the agent who develops the hearers through those stages. The possessive is therefore relational and formative, not merely titular.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 72:18-20 repeat the fixed structure almost mechanically: exclusive service/calling is paired again with `أَحَدًا`, confirming that `ش ر ك` B001 is a blocked participation slot rather than only a rejected named rival. Yet 72:21-23 add a corrective surprise: the exclusive relation does not transfer ownership of harm, guidance, or refuge to the messenger; his positive authority remains delivery.

baseline.text: O, doğru yola iletiyor; biz de ona inandık. Rabbimize asla hiç kimseyi ortak koşmayacağız.

findings.text: Doğru yola iletme, bilgi vermekle kalmaz; yargıyı ve davranışı uygulanabilir bir doğrultuda yeniden düzenler.
İnanma ile ortak koşmama tek bir güvenlik hareketi oluşturur: bölünmüş bağlılığın sona ermesi, yanlış sığınma ilişkilerinin ürettiği güvensizliği kaldırır.
Surede daha sonra beliren ayrılmış yollar ışığında ortak koşma, rakip güzergâhların kesişiminde tutulma veya tuzağa düşme gibi mekânsal bir boyut kazanır.
Rab sözü, işitenleri aşama aşama düzelten ve olgunlaştıran bir yönetimi de anlatır.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1: Concealed Dispatch Becomes Epistemic Commitment
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A message moves through controlled stages from hidden transmission to audible form, understanding, and committed response; failure occurs when speech detaches from that chain.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The lexical network treats revelation less as a static text than as a custody chain whose successive operations can be contrasted with the uncontrolled manufacture and circulation of claims.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Hearing becomes direction, comprehension, and secure assent
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Received sound is understood and obeyed, takes the form of a leading direction, reaches a sound course of action, and settles as trust rather than mere acoustic contact.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: understanding and compliance after hearing (`quranic:root_000741:B003/m01`); gentle direction toward a road or truth (`quranic:root_001583:B001/m01`); an affair's orientation and manner (`quranic:root_001583:B002/m01`); a guide or leading front (`quranic:root_001583:B003/m01`); a straight route away from error (`quranic:root_000565:B001/m01`); sound practical judgment (`quranic:root_000565:B002/m01`); inward security and trust (`quranic:root_000054:B001/m01`); assent that quiets the heart (`quranic:root_000054:B002/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Hearing is extended from a bodily event into an ordered transition: comprehension, compliance, orientation, and practical judgment. The guide can be both a person at the front and the leading edge of a moving body, so the heard message does not merely indicate a road; it reorganizes the hearer into a following position. Faith is the resulting settled trust, not a second, unrelated theme.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1: Exclusive Sovereignty Closes Household Succession
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Possession, partnership, household formation, and biological continuation are alternative mechanisms for extending authority, and the pericope denies that the Lord's exalted rule depends on any of them.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The denial of consort and child is expanded into a complete social and reproductive chain, from acquisition and marriage through gestation, birth, and derivative continuation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Rule is neither acquired nor shared
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A possessor acquires and governs an object, but the asserted sovereignty is elevated beyond acquisition, negotiated partnership, or division into shares.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: lordship, possession, and command (`quranic:root_000532:B001/m01`); nurture and completion under a governor (`quranic:root_000532:B002/m01`); taking into one's possession (`quranic:root_000018:B001/m01`); acquisition for oneself (`quranic:root_000018:B010/m01`); partnership and shared share (`quranic:root_000791:B001/m01`); assigning a partner to God (`quranic:root_000791:B002/m01`); singularity (`quranic:root_000017:B001/m01`); exhaustive exclusion of any participant (`quranic:root_000017:B002/m01`); elevation (`quranic:root_001042:B001/m01`); rank and honor (`quranic:root_001042:B002/m01`); prevailing mastery (`quranic:root_001042:B004/m01`); greatness of standing (`quranic:root_000227:B001/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Taking and partnership describe ordinary ways in which a domain is acquired, divided, and jointly administered. Singularity and exhaustive negation close those routes, while elevation and greatness place the Lord beyond the social mechanics by which a human ruler secures or extends possession. Nurture remains active, but it proceeds from sovereignty rather than producing it.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1: Exclusive Sovereignty Closes Household Succession
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Possession, partnership, household formation, and biological continuation are alternative mechanisms for extending authority, and the pericope denies that the Lord's exalted rule depends on any of them.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The denial of consort and child is expanded into a complete social and reproductive chain, from acquisition and marriage through gestation, birth, and derivative continuation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: The consort-to-lineage chain is denied in full
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Companionship can become marriage, marriage can establish a household, the womb can conceal and gather a fetus, and birth can continue a line; the surface denial cuts this entire chain.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: companionship and sustained association (`quranic:root_000844:B001/m01`); making something a continuing companion (`quranic:root_000844:B004/m01`); a child growing into a companion (`quranic:root_000844:B005/m01`); marital partnership (`quranic:root_000791:B003/m01`); a stepchild and household guardian (`quranic:root_000532:B005/m01`); a bride conveyed to a husband (`quranic:root_001583:B006/m01`); a fetus concealed in the womb (`quranic:root_000266:B007/m01`); a womb gathering a pregnancy (`quranic:root_001210:B004/m01`); offspring (`quranic:root_001683:B001/m01`); parenthood (`quranic:root_001683:B002/m01`); parturition (`quranic:root_001683:B003/m01`); a newborn or young dependent (`quranic:root_001683:B004/m01`); generation of one thing from another (`quranic:root_001683:B005/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Lexical branches supply the stages suppressed by the terse surface negation: association, marital transfer, household incorporation, concealment in a womb, delivery, and derived continuation. Because these are successive operations rather than a list of family terms, the channel sharpens the claim: divine sovereignty neither originates in a household alliance nor persists through reproductive succession.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1: Refuge Brokerage Reverses into Encroachment
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A protection relation should place a vulnerable party within another's shelter, but the human-jinn arrangement reverses the roles and enlarges the very pressure it was meant to contain.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Refuge appears as a social contract, a physical enclosure, and an occult appliance; every form is vulnerable to capture by the broker who claims to provide it.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Protective devices become means of restraint
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A charm, amulet, shield, hidden place, or divinatory procedure is installed to ward off danger, yet the same apparatus can immobilize judgment or hold its user.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: an incantation or bead that restrains marriage or opinion (`quranic:root_000018:B004/m01`); amulet and protective recitation (`quranic:root_001059:B002/m01`); a shield used for defense (`quranic:root_000266:B008/m01`); a hiding place (`quranic:root_000266:B017/m01`); a covenant of protection (`quranic:root_000532:B011/m01`); divination by pebbles or traced marks (`quranic:root_000932:B004/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The protective field is materially complete: spoken formula, portable amulet, shield, hiding place, covenant, and divinatory reading. The crucial reversal is already present inside the evidence: the charm that should secure its bearer can instead bind a person or arrest a decision. That reversal prepares the surface outcome in which recourse to hidden protectors increases rather than relieves exposure.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1: Sky Listening Becomes a Reversed Hunt
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Seekers approach an upper listening ground as hunters, but the defended boundary converts their observation post into a prepared ambush against them.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The sky defense is assembled from reconnaissance, stalking, blinds, snares, prepared stations, and projectile force, making the listeners both hunters and hunted.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: The listening blind is itself trapped
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A watcher sits in concealment to intercept sound, but the route and station have already been prepared as an ambush and snare.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: fixed sitting place (`quranic:root_001244:B001/m01`); sitting in surveillance (`quranic:root_001244:B005/m01`); auditory capture (`quranic:root_000741:B001/m01`); the ear as receiving aperture (`quranic:root_000741:B002/m01`); watch and ambush (`quranic:root_000566:B001/m01`); prepared allocation (`quranic:root_000566:B002/m01`); a designated watch-place or trap (`quranic:root_000566:B003/m01`); hunter's snare (`quranic:root_000791:B006/m01`); set trap (`quranic:root_000932:B013/m01`); stalking behind cover (`quranic:root_000473:B003/m01`); defensive screen (`quranic:root_000266:B008/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Sitting, watching, and listening define a concealed observation post. The trap branches reverse its direction: the same route on which the listener waits is a prepared capture point, and the hunter's blind becomes the defender's snare. This role reversal explains the abrupt replacement of access by interception without reducing the scene to generic "security."

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1: A Community Is Sorted into Cuts, Tracks, and Measured Alignment
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Collective difference is materialized as longitudinal cuts and traversable tracks, then evaluated by whether a course is straight, balanced, or structurally warped.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Social and moral differentiation becomes a fabrication process: material is cut into strips, laid as routes, checked against a straight measure, and rejected as crooked dry stock.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Rectitude is a searched-for and measured course
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A seeker deliberately pursues the best direction, follows a leading guide, tests the route for straightness and balance, and enters it through submission.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: deliberate search for the soundest option (`quranic:root_000314:B004/m01`); worthiness for the chosen course (`quranic:root_000314:B003/m01`); a straight path away from error (`quranic:root_000565:B001/m01`); sound practical disposal (`quranic:root_000565:B002/m01`); gentle route guidance (`quranic:root_001583:B001/m01`); orientation and manner (`quranic:root_001583:B002/m01`); safety from defect (`quranic:root_000737:B001/m01`); peaceful alignment (`quranic:root_000737:B004/m01`); a ladder or means of ascent (`quranic:root_000737:B006/m01`); surrender and handover (`quranic:root_000737:B012/m01`); equitable allocation (`quranic:root_001224:B001/m01`); straight balance (`quranic:root_001224:B004/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Rectitude is assembled from operations rather than labels: search, orientation, leading, checking, and surrender to the selected course. The ladder sense makes submission an enabling structure rather than inert passivity, while the balance converts justice into a calibration of the path.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1: Security Settles an Account between Shortfall and Overload
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Trust is represented as a protected settlement in which neither value nor capacity is reduced and no extra burden is imposed.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The promise attached to faith is framed simultaneously as psychological security and exact accounting, joining the heart's calm to a balanced ledger.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Trust replaces anticipated harm with inward security
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Received guidance produces assent and an inward state that no longer projects or displays approaching harm.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: inward safety and reliability (`quranic:root_000054:B001/m01`); trusted assent (`quranic:root_000054:B002/m01`); fear as expectation of injury (`quranic:root_000447:B001/m01`); inducing another's fear (`quranic:root_000447:B002/m01`); visible manifestation of fear (`quranic:root_000447:B005/m01`); comprehension and compliance (`quranic:root_000741:B003/m01`); direction toward truth (`quranic:root_001583:B001/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Security is both an inner quiet and a reliable relation, while fear is both anticipated injury and its outward sign. Hearing understood as compliance supplies the transition between them: trusted assent changes not only a proposition but the hearer's projected relation to future harm.

pericope.label: The jinn hear the Quran and submit

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, yanılgının karşıtı olan doğru yönelişi, yolu veya doğruyu incelikle gösterip tanıtmayı, gösterileni benimsemeyi ve ilahi başarı desteğini birlikte kapsar. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu çekirdeği doğru biçimde yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, sıradan bir armağanı ya da yalnızca yolun kendisini değil, doğru yönü bildirme ve ona yönelme ilişkisini anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak dal anlamı tanımlanır; başka dallardaki armağan, adanmış sunu ve özel kullanım anlamları buraya taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir kimseye yolu, doğruyu ya da benimsenmesi gereken yönü incelikle göstermek ve tanıtmak; gösterilen yönü kabul ederek doğruya ulaşmak, ayrıca bunun ilahi başarı desteğiyle gerçekleşmesidir.

facets.statement: Doğru yönü, yolu veya gerçeği incelikle göstermek, açıklamak ve tanıtmaktır.
Gösterilen doğru yönü isteyerek kabul etme ve ona ulaşma sürecini de kapsar.
Dinsel doğruya yöneltme ve bu yönelişi mümkün kılan ilahi başarı desteği özel bir gerçekleşmedir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar doğru yönü gösterme, yolu tanıtma ve yanılgının karşıtı olan doğruya erişme çekirdeğinde birleşir; anlatım, insanın gösterileni seçip benimsemesini ve ilahi başarı desteğini de içerir. Bir kaynakta itaat ve sakınma da bu anlam alanındaki gerçekleşmeler arasında sayılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü bir işin yönünü ve amacını, kişinin gidişini, görünür tutumunu ve yöntemini, ayrıca sürmekte olan söz veya işi bırakmamayı birlikte verir. Verilen çerçeve bu çok parçalı fakat bağlantılı kullanımı korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca genel bir yaşam tarzı değildir; yön ve amaç bildiren kullanımlarla belirli bir işte veya söylemde kalma kullanımını da içerir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yön, gidiş ve tutum bildiren biçimler ile kalıplaşmış benzerlik ve yineleme kullanımları ayrı yüzler olarak tutulur; özel kullanımlar çıplak kökün tümüne yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir işin yönü, amacı ve izlenen doğrultusu ile bir kimsenin gidişi, görünür tutumu ve yöntemidir. Belirli anlatımlarda yürütülen söz ya da işten sapmama, başkasının yolunu izleme, ona benzeme veya aynı karşılığı yineleme anlamı kazanır.

facets.statement: Bir işin yönünü, hedefini ve izlenen doğrultusunu bildirir.
Bir kimsenin gidişini, görünür tutumunu ve izlediği yöntemi anlatır.
Sürmekte olan söz veya işi bırakmama ve başkasının izlediği yolu izleme kullanımını içerir.
Özel bir söyleyişte benzerini verme veya aynı işi yeniden yapma anlamı taşır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynak anlatımı yön ve amaç ile kişinin izlediği yol ve görünür tutumu aynı kavramsal alanda toplar; sürmekte olan işten sapmama, başkasının yolunu izleme ve özel bir söyleyişte benzerini ya da tekrarını yapma kullanımları buna bağlıdır.
